title: Cognotik Session File System Access
overview: A walkthrough demonstrating how to access and use the file system backing each Cognotik session, including directory browsing, file viewing in multiple formats (markdown, HTML, PDF, text), zip download, built-in Git version control, and physical file system path access for development environments.

finalStructure.description: Intro billboard: fade in from black, display title card 'Session File System Access'
Segment 1: Introduction – navigating to the session file system URL and accessing the root directory
Segment 2: File system features overview – zip download, browsing markdown and HTML files
Segment 3: Markdown viewing options – download as markdown, view as HTML (dynamic rendering), view as text, view as PDF (dynamic rendering)
Segment 4: Built-in Git version control – status, commit, explanation of Git as a time machine for file changes
Segment 5: Summary – the file system interface as a powerful backdoor providing hackability and transparency for Cognotik applications
Segment 6: Physical file system location, mounting with dev environments, file explorer access, closing remarks
Outro billboard: fade to black, display thanks card with links and CTA
